stances.summary: State-sponsored spyware targeting activists and students is a serious threat
stances.quote: Apple's latest round of state-sponsored hacking notifications is starting to bear fruit. Students and opposition activists were targeted with spyware in Serbia. Pegasus was installed remotely. NoviSpy was installed while a target was being held in police custody. www.ft.com/conte

stances.summary: Questions app's security claims without evidence
stances.quote: This is not a claim that Keet or its developers appear to make on their website. If I somehow missed the place where Keet claims it protects your messages against endpoint compromise, please feel free to link and quote.

stances.summary: Criticizes incorrect digital privacy advice online
stances.quote: I am clearly not one of the most influential posters on BlueSky because people are still here giving incorrect digital privacy and security advice.

stances.summary: Challenges claim that encryption protects compromised endpoints
stances.quote: Yes, you are correct. I just don't understand enough about how end-to-end encryption protects the contents of a message on an endpoint that has been fully compromised. I will need you to explain it to me.

stances.summary: Asserts no messenger app protects compromised endpoint messages
stances.quote: There is no messenger app on your phone that protects the contents of your communication once the endpoint has been compromised.

stances.summary: Mass surveillance tools warrant public attention and resistance
stances.quote: Is Flock the only mass surveillance tool/network that people should be worried about? No. But it is an entry point for people from all walks of life to the fight against mass surveillance and I'm glad people are paying attention and taking action.

stances.summary: Skeptical of tech critics engaging in interpersonal disputes
stances.quote: It's that time of day where I can't tell if I'm having a lot of feelings about tech critics taking pot shots at other tech critics or if I just need a sandwich.

stances.summary: Expresses frustration with Meta privacy settlement terms
stances.quote: Reading the Meta settlement and I'm very tired and I just want someone else to tell me why I hate this.

stances.summary: Warns non-technical people about real cybersecurity threat

stances.summary: Private accounts needed for harassment protection on social platforms
stances.quote: There are a lot of people who want alternatives to Facebook or X for whom BlueSky is not a viable solution because they can't have private posts or accounts. Taking your account private and locking your posts is also an important tool for fighting harassment/pile-ons.

stances.summary: Criticizes police use of surveillance technology for harassment and intimidation
stances.quote: I post a lot of stories about cops using Flock to stalk former or current partners, but don't forget that cops also use Flock to intimidate and harass people who try to hold them accountable.

stances.summary: Argues some offenders should face delayed justice or consequences
stances.quote: Everyone deserves to be free. But some people deserve to be freed last.

stances.summary: Police use facial recognition tool to stalk intimate partners systematically

stances.summary: Police face minimal consequences for abusing surveillance access
stances.quote: If you're writing a story about police abusing Flock access to stalk current/former/potential partners, I'm begging you to please follow up on the consequences these cops face for getting caught, because a lot of the time it's barely more than a slap on the wrist.

stances.summary: Police propaganda contributes to surveillance normalization
stances.quote: There are many factors that got us here, but copaganda is certainly on the list.

stances.summary: Police exploit surveillance networks despite claimed oversight
stances.quote: “Flock has already claimed that they have oversight, that they have guardrails," yet we still see police officers using these camera networks to stalk women, EFF’s @evacide.bsky.social told The @washingtonpost.com. www.washingtonpost.com/technology/...

stances.summary: Mass surveillance cannot be made safe; surveillance tools must be eliminated
stances.quote:
You cannot make mass surveillance "safe" or "good" by adding more guardrails. The only way to make Flock safe is to get rid of Flock.

www.gpb.org/news/2026/08...

stances.summary: Meta settlement favors company over public interest in content moderation

stances.summary: Dismisses opinions from those unfamiliar with Meta settlement details
stances.quote: I really cannot emphasize how little interest I have in the opinions of people who have not actually read the settlement.

stances.summary: Criticizes uninformed commentary on Meta settlement without reading source material
stances.quote:
I have made a terrible error. I should have specified "I want someone else WHO HAS READ THE ENTIRE SETTLEMENT to explain to me why I hate this." 

The number of people who thought I was asking for their hot take based on vibes was...not small.

stances.summary: Quality of Meta settlement analysis varies by degree of source document engagement
